name: 33055 · Miami Gardens, FL
findings: ZIP 33055 (Miami Gardens) has 96 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (53% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33055 (Miami Gardens) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
